oracle: 600 seeded code points compared with codecs.decode(..., unicode_escape), plus available Unicode names; aliases and named-sequence rejection separately checked.
limitations: Lexical candidates are not a Python parse or an intent/safety verdict. Raw strings, comments and bytes literals can match without Python interpretation.
No literal-Unicode analysis, font rendering, recursive decoding or surrogate-pair combining.
Checks are local observations, not independent certification.
